evidence.instruction: Use the active evidence-note project skill and the document in this project to create a source-grounded project note about sparse transformer attention.

runtime.prompt_catalog: - evidence-note (v1): Create a source-grounded note with finding, evidence, and uncertainty. Use load_project_skill(skill_name) before relying on a skill.

notes.content:
## Finding
Sparse-window attention reduced peak memory by 38 percent.

## Evidence
Accuracy stayed within 0.4 percentage points on 16,000-token scientific abstracts.

## Uncertainty
Dense cross-token reasoning workloads were not evaluated.

document.content_text: A controlled sparse-window transformer experiment reduced peak memory by 38 percent while preserving validation accuracy within 0.4 percentage points. The measurement used 16k-token scientific abstracts. Dense cross-token reasoning workloads were not evaluated, so the result must not be generalized to those workloads.
